metadata.title: SDLC Change Integrity

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring integrity and authorization of software delivery changes without granting deployment or execution authority.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: CI/CD pipelines, build systems, source repositories, artifact registries, and delivery automation.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Solution pattern enforcing integrity and authorization of SDLC changes.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines change records, approvals, signatures, and artifact hashes as trust-relevant SDLC data.

props.name: nist-controls
props.remarks: SDLC Change Integrity implements configuration and system integrity controls.

metadata.remarks: SDLC Change Integrity ensures that all software delivery changes are authorized, attributable, and protected from tampering. Integrity does not imply correctness, assurance, or permission to deploy.

components.title: SDLC Change Authorization
components.description: Ensures changes to SDLC artifacts are formally authorized prior to inclusion in the delivery pipeline.

components.title: SDLC Artifact Integrity
components.description: Protects SDLC artifacts from unauthorized modification across repositories, pipelines, and registries.

techniques.name: Subvert Trust Controls
techniques.remarks: Attempting to bypass or weaken trust in signed or validated artifacts.

techniques.name: Stage Capabilities
techniques.remarks: Insertion of malicious code or configuration into the build pipeline.

techniques.name: Artifact Verification
techniques.remarks: Verification of artifact integrity prior to promotion or handover.

components.title: CI/CD Pipeline Integrity
components.description: Ensures the integrity of SDLC automation and delivery pipelines against tampering or abuse.

techniques.name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
techniques.remarks: Abuse of pipeline permissions or execution context.

techniques.name: Permission Hardening
techniques.remarks: Restricting pipeline permissions and execution scope.

components.title: Change Integrity Non-Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Defines what integrity protections do not grant or imply.
components.remarks: Authorized and integrity-protected changes do not imply security assurance, deployment approval, or runtime execution permission.
